mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has fallen in three of the last four weeks, with the steepest drop (-59.0) in the most recent week; this downward momentum reflects accumulating caution and restriction effects that persist autocorrelated over the next month, pushing the 4-week mean lower.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC fell from -56.4 to -59.0 in the latest week
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC's next 28-day mean is higher than its last 28-day mean despite the recent week-on-week decline, the momentum hypothesis is rejected.
